Asha: Heads-up: planning a small experiment to change deploybot behavior for runtime 4.0 -> prefer header-based soft-routing before pinning. Target window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. cc @Ravi @Marta

deploybot: Observed mismatch: sdk=3.4 vs runtime=4.0, default -> hard pin queued (id=pin-4140001234).

Ravi: Agree trying soft route first. Proposal: add X-Compat:soft header for 0.5% traffic, evaluate `compat_metric` returned by SDK. If >=0.9 continue, if <0.9 route to regional-variant, only hard-pin after 10m sustained errors.

Marta: add runbook: rollback and pin if error_rate >1.5% OR p95 > 2x baseline for 10m. Rollback command: `deployctl pin --runtime=3.4 --reason=softroute-fail`

Asha: config snippet we'll use:
```
soft_route: true
percent: 0.5
compat_threshold: 0.9
deadman_minutes: 15
```

infra-bot: Canary launched -> softroute-4140001234 in eu-west at 02:05 UTC. Logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/softroute-4140001234

Ravi: please ensure deploybot emits `softroute.event` with canary id and compat_metric. I'll wire alerts for error_rate and p95.

Marta: I'll prep the support blurb in case customers hit degradations. Keep canary logs for 14d.

Asha: thanks team — will post postmortem here after 90m.
